replay_controls.mutant: Only original already-opened standard_init4; mutate generated stage index 1's new constant by +17. Must produce a SAT counterexample to at least one original clause (unknown not sufficient).
replay_controls.valid_dev: 49/49 source clause UNSAT proofs already preserved in original dev first. No changes or re-running optimization based on new heldout.

scientific_gates.PASS: all three heldout original source SHA match, same code blob SHA; every original Horn clause negation independently UNSAT; validator mutant definitively SAT; 3/3 predeclared targets succeed without code changes; all original source evidence retained.
scientific_gates.FAIL: any target's original proof SAT or UNKNOWN or error; no source-specific patch/retry to call FIRST; post-first improvements separate.
scientific_gates.SCOPE: Classical typed parametric invariant generalization within array-fill class, NOT trained NN autonomous invention and NOT cross-domain/formalism.
